name: Self Pity 2
overview: Scripture reveals that self-pity often arises from feelings of abandonment and despair, as seen in David's lament of feeling forgotten by the Lord and Jeremiah's curse upon his own birth. Yet, the Bible redirects believers from such sorrow by reminding them of God's sustaining help in times of trial and the blessing found in spiritual poverty. Jesus invites those who are burdened to come to Him for rest, while Paul encourages rejoicing in tribulations because they produce endurance. Together, these verses teach that while self-pity may surface in hardship, true hope and strength come from trusting in God's presence and promises.
